The description does not mention the value axis (horizontal axis) or its characteristics. It omits that this axis has no label, no scale markings, and that the values are instead presented as data labels next to each bar.
The description omits the central context of the chart, which is a comparison of healthcare access for 'the rich' versus 'the poor', as stated in the title question.
For a horizontal bar chart, the word 'дължина' (length) is much clearer than 'височина' (height) when describing the magnitude of the bars.
